api/Invex.StructuredText.AzureDevopsPipe.summary: Class DevopsExpressionPrinter Namespace Invex.StructuredText.AzureDevopsPipelines Assembly Invex.StructuredText.AzureDevopsPipelines.dll Renders typed expressions (Expr) and Templates to Azure DevOps syntax. Operators are functions (and(...), or(...), not(...), eq(...), …) and status checks are succeeded(), failed(), canceled() and always(). public sealed class DevopsExpressionPrinter : ExpressionPrinter Inheritance object ExpressionPrinter DevopsExpressionPrinter Inherited Members ExpressionPrinter.Print(Expr) ExpressionPrinter.RenderOrNull(Template) ExpressionPrinter.PrintOrNull(Expr) ExpressionPrinter.IsDotAccessible(string) Remarks Inside a Template, secrets, variables, matrix values and step outputs are written as macros ($(name)). Expressions that depend on other jobs (job outputs, job results) or contain a DevopsRuntimeExpr are runtime expressions ($[ … ]), and everything else is a template expression (${{ … }}). Combinations Azure DevOps can't evaluate throw System.NotSupportedException: a runtime expression combined with text or other expressions (Azure DevOps only evaluates one that is the whole value), an input read in a runtime expression or condition (parameters only exist at compile time), and a secret, matrix value or step output inside a compound compile-time expression (they only exist at run time). Bind the value to a variable and reference it with Variable(string) instead. Inside an expression, secrets, variables and matrix values are variables['name'], inputs are parameters.name, job outputs are dependencies.JOB.outputs['STEP.NAME'] and job results are dependencies.JOB.result. Constructors DevopsExpressionPrinter() public DevopsExpressionPrinter() Properties Instance A shared instance. The printer is stateless. public static DevopsExpressionPrinter Instance { get; } Property Value DevopsExpressionPrinter Methods FunctionName(string) Maps a canonical function name (see FunctionNames) to the platform's name. Returns the name unchanged by default. protected override string FunctionName(string name) Parameters name string The canonical name. Returns string The platform's name. PrintCall(string, IReadOnlyList<Expr>) Renders a function call. Writes FunctionName(string) followed by the arguments in order by default; platforms whose functions take arguments in a different order override this. protected override string PrintCall(string name, IReadOnlyList<Expr> arguments) Parameters name string The canonical function name (see FunctionNames). arguments IReadOnlyList<Expr> The arguments, in canonical order. Returns string The rendered call. Remarks Azure DevOps's join takes the separator first and requires it, so the arguments are swapped and a missing separator becomes ','. PrintComparison(ComparisonExpr) Renders a comparison. Uses infix operators (==, !=, <, …) by default. protected override (string Text, int Precedence) PrintComparison(ComparisonExpr comparison) Parameters comparison ComparisonExpr The comparison. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintCondition(BoolExpr) Renders a condition: value. Azure DevOps evaluates conditions at run time, so they are written without delimiters. public string PrintCondition(BoolExpr condition) Parameters condition BoolExpr The condition. Returns string The rendered condition. Exceptions NotSupportedException Thrown when the condition reads an input (a parameter). PrintLogical(LogicalExpr) Renders an AND or OR. Uses infix && and || by default. protected override (string Text, int Precedence) PrintLogical(LogicalExpr logical) Parameters logical LogicalExpr The logical expression. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintMember(string) Renders a property access suffix: .name where valid, otherwise ['name'] with quotes escaped. protected override string PrintMember(string name) Parameters name string The property name. Returns string The suffix to append to the target. Remarks Azure DevOps identifiers can't contain -, so names that aren't letters, digits and _ use ['name']. PrintNot(NotExpr) Renders a negation. Uses prefix ! by default. protected override (string Text, int Precedence) PrintNot(NotExpr not) Parameters not NotExpr The negation. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintOther(Expr) Renders a node the base class doesn't know, such as a platform-specific node. Throws System.NotSupportedException by default. protected override (string Text, int Precedence) PrintOther(Expr expression) Parameters expression Expr The node. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintReference(ReferenceExpr) Renders a portable reference such as a secret or a job output. protected override string PrintReference(ReferenceExpr reference) Parameters reference ReferenceExpr The reference. Returns string The rendered text. PrintResult(RunResult) Renders a run result literal. protected override string PrintResult(RunResult result) Parameters result RunResult The result. Returns string The rendered text. Render(Template) Renders template: literal text as-is, embedded expressions wrapped with WrapEmbedded(string). public override string Render(Template template) Parameters template Template The template. Returns string The rendered text. Exceptions NotSupportedException Thrown when the template contains an expression, or a combination of expressions and text, the platform can't express. RenderEmbedded(Expr) Renders an expression embedded in a Template. By default it is printed and wrapped with WrapEmbedded(string); platforms with several embedding syntaxes override this. protected override string RenderEmbedded(Expr expression) Parameters expression Expr The embedded expression. Returns string The rendered text. WrapEmbedded(string) Wraps a rendered expression that is embedded in literal text, e.g. in expression delimiters. protected override string WrapEmbedded(string printedExpression) Parameters printedExpression string The rendered expression. Returns string The wrapped text.

api/Invex.StructuredText.AzureDevopsPipe.summary: Namespace Invex.StructuredText.AzureDevopsPipelines.DevopsPipelineModel.Steps Classes SettableVariables Restrictions on which variables can be set from a step. Step Steps are a linear sequence of operations that make up a job. Step.Bash Runs a script in Bash on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Step.Checkout Configure how the pipeline checks out source code. Step.Download Downloads artifacts associated with the current run or from another Azure Pipeline. Step.DownloadBuild Downloads build artifacts. Step.GetPackage Downloads a package from a package management feed in Azure Artifacts or Azure DevOps Server. Step.PowerShell Runs a script using either Windows PowerShell (on Windows) or pwsh (Linux and macOS). Step.Publish Publishes (uploads) a file or folder as a pipeline artifact. Step.Pwsh Runs a script in PowerShell Core on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Step.ReviewApp Creates a resource dynamically under a deploy phase provider. Step.Script Runs a script using cmd.exe on Windows and Bash on other platforms. Step.Task Runs a task. Step.Template Reference to a step template. Step0MatchExtensions StepTarget Environment in which to run a step. StepTarget.TargetName Simple target name. StepTarget.TargetSpec Full target specification. StepTarget0MatchExtensions

api/Invex.StructuredText.Expressions.Exp.title: Class ExpressionPrinter | Invex.StructuredText
api/Invex.StructuredText.Expressions.Exp.summary: Class ExpressionPrinter Namespace Invex.StructuredText.Expressions Assembly Invex.StructuredText.dll Renders typed expression trees (Expr) and Templates to platform syntax. public abstract class ExpressionPrinter Inheritance object ExpressionPrinter Derived DevopsExpressionPrinter GithubExpressionPrinter Remarks The base class handles operator precedence (adding parentheses only where needed), literal quoting and escaping, casts, raw text and context paths. Platforms override the members that differ: how operators and functions are spelled, how ReferenceExpr nodes and ResultLiterals are written, and how an embedded expression is delimited inside a Template. Nodes the printer doesn't recognise cause a System.NotSupportedException. Constructors ExpressionPrinter() protected ExpressionPrinter() Fields AndPrecedence Precedence of AND. protected const int AndPrecedence = 2 Field Value int AtomPrecedence Precedence of atoms: literals, paths, calls and access. protected const int AtomPrecedence = 5 Field Value int ComparisonPrecedence Precedence of comparisons. protected const int ComparisonPrecedence = 3 Field Value int NotPrecedence Precedence of unary NOT. protected const int NotPrecedence = 4 Field Value int OrPrecedence Precedence of OR. protected const int OrPrecedence = 1 Field Value int RawPrecedence Precedence given to raw text that isn't a plain dotted path. It is the lowest, so raw text is parenthesized whenever it is nested inside an operator, and written verbatim when it stands alone. protected const int RawPrecedence = 0 Field Value int Methods FunctionName(string) Maps a canonical function name (see FunctionNames) to the platform's name. Returns the name unchanged by default. protected virtual string FunctionName(string name) Parameters name string The canonical name. Returns string The platform's name. IsDotAccessible(string) true when name can be written with property dereference (.name): letters, digits, _ and -, not starting with a digit or -. public static bool IsDotAccessible(string name) Parameters name string The property name. Returns bool Whether dot syntax is valid for the name. Print(Expr) Renders expression as an expression (without template delimiters). public string Print(Expr expression) Parameters expression Expr The expression. Returns string The rendered text. Print(Expr, int) Renders expression, adding parentheses when its precedence is below minimumPrecedence. protected string Print(Expr expression, int minimumPrecedence) Parameters expression Expr The expression. minimumPrecedence int The lowest precedence that may appear without parentheses. Returns string The rendered text. PrintCall(string, IReadOnlyList<Expr>) Renders a function call. Writes FunctionName(string) followed by the arguments in order by default; platforms whose functions take arguments in a different order override this. protected virtual string PrintCall(string name, IReadOnlyList<Expr> arguments) Parameters name string The canonical function name (see FunctionNames). arguments IReadOnlyList<Expr> The arguments, in canonical order. Returns string The rendered call. PrintComparison(ComparisonExpr) Renders a comparison. Uses infix operators (==, !=, <, …) by default. protected virtual (string Text, int Precedence) PrintComparison(ComparisonExpr comparison) Parameters comparison ComparisonExpr The comparison. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintLogical(LogicalExpr) Renders an AND or OR. Uses infix && and || by default. protected virtual (string Text, int Precedence) PrintLogical(LogicalExpr logical) Parameters logical LogicalExpr The logical expression. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintMember(string) Renders a property access suffix: .name where valid, otherwise ['name'] with quotes escaped. protected virtual string PrintMember(string name) Parameters name string The property name. Returns string The suffix to append to the target. PrintNot(NotExpr) Renders a negation. Uses prefix ! by default. protected virtual (string Text, int Precedence) PrintNot(NotExpr not) Parameters not NotExpr The negation. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintOrNull(Expr?) Renders expression, or returns null when it is null. public string? PrintOrNull(Expr? expression) Parameters expression Expr The expression. Returns string The rendered text, or null. PrintOther(Expr) Renders a node the base class doesn't know, such as a platform-specific node. Throws System.NotSupportedException by default. protected virtual (string Text, int Precedence) PrintOther(Expr expression) Parameters expression Expr The node. Returns (string Text, int Precedence) The rendered text and its precedence. PrintReference(ReferenceExpr) Renders a portable reference such as a secret or a job output. protected abstract string PrintReference(ReferenceExpr reference) Parameters reference ReferenceExpr The reference. Returns string The rendered text. PrintResult(RunResult) Renders a run result literal. protected abstract string PrintResult(RunResult result) Parameters result RunResult The result. Returns string The rendered text. QuoteString(string) Quotes and escapes a string literal. Uses single quotes, doubling embedded single quotes, by default. protected virtual string QuoteString(string value) Parameters value string The unquoted value. Returns string The literal. Render(Template) Renders template: literal text as-is, embedded expressions wrapped with WrapEmbedded(string). public virtual string Render(Template template) Parameters template Template The template. Returns string The rendered text. Exceptions NotSupportedException Thrown when the template contains an expression, or a combination of expressions and text, the platform can't express. Returns string The rendered text. RenderOrNull(Template?) Renders template, or returns null when it is null. public string? RenderOrNull(Template? template) Parameters template Template The template. Returns string The rendered text, or null. WrapEmbedded(string) Wraps a rendered expression that is embedded in literal text, e.g. in expression delimiters. protected abstract string WrapEmbedded(string printedExpression) Parameters printedExpression string The rendered expression. Returns string The wrapped text.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.CheckRun.CheckRunType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the check_run event. public enum On.CheckRun.CheckRunType Fields completed = 4 Runs when a check run has completed. created = 0 Runs when a new check run is created. [Obsolete("GitHub never sends the 'deleted' activity type for check_run, so a workflow filtered on it never runs. Use created, rerequested, completed or requested_action instead.")] deleted = 2 Emits the deleted activity type. GitHub does not document deleted for the check_run event (documented types: created, rerequested, completed, requested_action), so a workflow filtered on it never runs. [Obsolete("GitHub never sends the 'edited' activity type for check_run, so a workflow filtered on it never runs. Use created, rerequested, completed or requested_action instead.")] edited = 1 Emits the edited activity type. GitHub does not document edited for the check_run event (documented types: created, rerequested, completed, requested_action), so a workflow filtered on it never runs. requested_action = 5 Runs when someone requests an action provided by a check run. rerequested = 3 Runs when someone requests a check run to be re-run.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.Discussion.DiscussionType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the discussion event. public enum On.Discussion.DiscussionType Fields answered = 11 Runs when a comment on a discussion is marked as the answer. category_changed = 10 Runs when a discussion is moved to a different category. created = 0 Runs when a discussion is created. deleted = 2 Runs when a discussion is deleted. edited = 1 Runs when the title or body of a discussion is edited. labeled = 6 Runs when a label is added to a discussion. locked = 8 Runs when a discussion is locked. pinned = 4 Runs when a discussion is pinned. transferred = 3 Runs when a discussion is transferred to another repository. unanswered = 12 Runs when a comment is unmarked as the answer to a discussion. unlabeled = 7 Runs when a label is removed from a discussion. unlocked = 9 Runs when a discussion is unlocked. unpinned = 5 Runs when a discussion is unpinned.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.Issues.IssuesType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the issues event. public enum On.Issues.IssuesType Fields assigned = 8 Runs when an issue is assigned to a user. closed = 6 Runs when an issue is closed. deleted = 2 Runs when an issue is deleted. demilestoned = 15 Runs when an issue is removed from a milestone. edited = 1 Runs when the title or body of an issue is edited. labeled = 10 Runs when a label is added to an issue. locked = 12 Runs when conversation on an issue is locked. milestoned = 14 Runs when an issue is added to a milestone. opened = 0 Runs when an issue is opened. pinned = 4 Runs when an issue is pinned. reopened = 7 Runs when a closed issue is reopened. transferred = 3 Runs when an issue is transferred to another repository. typed = 16 Runs when an issue type is set on an issue. unassigned = 9 Runs when a user is unassigned from an issue. unlabeled = 11 Runs when a label is removed from an issue. unlocked = 13 Runs when conversation on an issue is unlocked. unpinned = 5 Runs when an issue is unpinned. untyped = 17 Runs when the issue type is removed from an issue.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.Project.ProjectType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the project event. public enum On.Project.ProjectType Fields closed = 2 Runs when a classic project is closed. created = 0 Runs when a classic project is created. deleted = 5 Runs when a classic project is deleted. edited = 4 Runs when the name or description of a classic project is edited. reopened = 3 Runs when a closed classic project is reopened. [Obsolete("GitHub never sends the 'updated' activity type for project, so a workflow filtered on it never runs. Use edited instead.")] updated = 1 Emits the updated activity type. GitHub does not document updated for the project event (documented types: created, closed, reopened, edited, deleted), so a workflow filtered on it never runs.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.PullRequest.PullRequestType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the pull_request event. public enum On.PullRequest.PullRequestType Fields assigned = 0 Runs when a pull request is assigned to a user. auto_merge_disabled = 18 Runs when auto-merge is disabled for a pull request. auto_merge_enabled = 17 Runs when auto-merge is enabled for a pull request. closed = 6 Runs when a pull request is closed, whether merged or not. converted_to_draft = 9 Runs when a pull request is converted to a draft. demilestoned = 14 Runs when a pull request is removed from a milestone. dequeued = 20 Runs when a pull request is removed from a merge queue. edited = 5 Runs when the title, body or base branch of a pull request is edited. enqueued = 19 Runs when a pull request is added to a merge queue. labeled = 2 Runs when a label is added to a pull request. locked = 11 Runs when conversation on a pull request is locked. milestoned = 13 Runs when a pull request is added to a milestone. opened = 4 Runs when a pull request is opened. ready_for_review = 10 Runs when a draft pull request is marked as ready for review. reopened = 7 Runs when a closed pull request is reopened. review_request_removed = 16 Runs when a review request is removed. review_requested = 15 Runs when a review is requested from a user or team. synchronize = 21 Runs when new commits are pushed to the pull request's head branch (GitHub's synchronize activity type). [Obsolete("GitHub never sends 'synchronized'; this member is written to YAML as 'synchronized' and never matches. Use synchronize instead.")] synchronized = 8 Intended for new commits being pushed to the pull request's head branch (GitHub's synchronize activity type). Note that it is written to YAML as synchronized, which GitHub does not recognize, so a workflow filtered on it never runs. Use synchronize instead. unassigned = 1 Runs when a user is unassigned from a pull request. unlabeled = 3 Runs when a label is removed from a pull request. unlocked = 12 Runs when conversation on a pull request is unlocked.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.PullRequestTarget.PullRequestTargetType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the pull_request_target event. public enum On.PullRequestTarget.PullRequestTargetType Fields assigned = 0 Runs when a pull request is assigned to a user. auto_merge_disabled = 18 Runs when auto-merge is disabled for a pull request. auto_merge_enabled = 17 Runs when auto-merge is enabled for a pull request. closed = 6 Runs when a pull request is closed, whether merged or not. converted_to_draft = 9 Runs when a pull request is converted to a draft. demilestoned = 14 Runs when a pull request is removed from a milestone. dequeued = 20 Runs when a pull request is removed from a merge queue. edited = 5 Runs when the title, body or base branch of a pull request is edited. enqueued = 19 Runs when a pull request is added to a merge queue. labeled = 2 Runs when a label is added to a pull request. locked = 11 Runs when conversation on a pull request is locked. milestoned = 13 Runs when a pull request is added to a milestone. opened = 4 Runs when a pull request is opened. ready_for_review = 10 Runs when a draft pull request is marked as ready for review. reopened = 7 Runs when a closed pull request is reopened. review_request_removed = 16 Runs when a review request is removed. review_requested = 15 Runs when a review is requested from a user or team. synchronize = 21 Runs when new commits are pushed to the pull request's head branch (GitHub's synchronize activity type). [Obsolete("GitHub never sends 'synchronized'; this member is written to YAML as 'synchronized' and never matches. Use synchronize instead.")] synchronized = 8 Intended for new commits being pushed to the pull request's head branch (GitHub's synchronize activity type). Note that it is written to YAML as synchronized, which GitHub does not recognize, so a workflow filtered on it never runs. Use synchronize instead. unassigned = 1 Runs when a user is unassigned from a pull request. unlabeled = 3 Runs when a label is removed from a pull request. unlocked = 12 Runs when conversation on a pull request is unlocked.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Enum On.Release.ReleaseType Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Activity types for the release event. public enum On.Release.ReleaseType Fields created = 2 Runs when a draft is saved or a release or pre-release is published without first being saved as a draft. deleted = 4 Runs when a release, pre-release or draft is deleted. edited = 3 Runs when a release, pre-release or draft is edited. prereleased = 5 Runs when a pre-release is published or a release is changed to a pre-release. published = 0 Runs when a release, pre-release or draft is published. released = 6 Runs when a release is published or a pre-release is changed to a full release. unpublished = 1 Runs when a published release or pre-release is unpublished.

api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Class On Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll A workflow trigger event (on). This is a discriminated union over the GitHub webhook events; construct the variant for the event you want, e.g. new On.Push { ... } or new On.Schedule(["0 6 * * 1"]). Enum member names intentionally match the lowercase/snake_case activity-type strings used in workflow YAML. api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.title: Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel | Invex.StructuredText
api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.GithubActionModel Classes Concurrency Concurrency settings (concurrency) that ensure only one run (or queued run) sharing the same group executes at a time, at either workflow or job level. Container A Docker container that a job runs in (container) or that hosts a service (services). Credentials Credentials for a private container registry (credentials), passed to docker login. Typically reference secrets, e.g. ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}. Environment The deployment environment a job targets (environment). Environments can carry protection rules and secrets configured in the repository settings. GithubAction The root model of a GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/*.yml). Serialize it with GithubActionWriter. Job A job within a workflow: a set of steps that execute on the same runner. Matrix A matrix of variable combinations to run a job with (strategy.matrix). On A workflow trigger event (on). This is a discriminated union over the GitHub webhook events; construct the variant for the event you want, e.g. new On.Push { ... } or new On.Schedule(["0 6 * * 1"]). Enum member names intentionally match the lowercase/snake_case activity-type strings used in workflow YAML. On.BranchProtectionRule Triggers when a branch protection rule changes (branch_protection_rule). On.CheckRun Triggers on check run activity (check_run). On.CheckSuite Triggers on check suite activity (check_suite). On.Create Triggers when a branch or tag is created (create). On.Delete Triggers when a branch or tag is deleted (delete). On.Deployment Triggers when a deployment is created (deployment). On.DeploymentStatus Triggers when a deployment status is provided (deployment_status). On.Discussion Triggers on discussion activity (discussion). On.DiscussionComment Triggers on discussion comment activity (discussion_comment). On.Fork Triggers when the repository is forked (fork). On.Gollum Triggers when the wiki is updated (gollum). On.ImageVersion Triggers on runner image version events (image_version). On.IssueComment Triggers on issue/pull-request comment activity (issue_comment). On.Issues Triggers on issue activity (issues). On.Label Triggers on label activity (label). On.MergeGroup Triggers when a pull request is added to a merge queue (merge_group). On.Milestone Triggers on milestone activity (milestone). On.PageBuild Triggers when someone pushes to the GitHub Pages publishing branch (page_build). On.Project Triggers on classic project activity (project). On.ProjectCard Triggers on classic project card activity (project_card). On.ProjectColumn Triggers on classic project column activity (project_column). On.Public Triggers when the repository changes from private to public (public). On.PullRequest Triggers on pull request activity (pull_request), with optional branch/tag/path filters. On.PullRequestReview Triggers on pull request review activity (pull_request_review). On.PullRequestReviewComment Triggers on pull request review comment activity (pull_request_review_comment). On.PullRequestTarget Triggers on pull request activity, running in the context of the base of the pull request (pull_request_target). Use with care — the workflow has access to repository secrets. On.Push Triggers when commits or tags are pushed (push), with optional branch/tag/path filters. All filter properties are required so that omissions are explicit; pass null for filters you do not want. On.RegistryPackage Triggers on registry package activity (registry_package). On.Release Triggers on release activity (release). On.RepositoryDispatch Triggers on a custom webhook event sent via the GitHub API (repository_dispatch). On.Schedule Triggers on a schedule (schedule). On.Status Triggers when the status of a commit changes (status). On.Watch Triggers when the repository is starred (watch). On.WorkflowCall Allows the workflow to be called from another workflow (workflow_call), making it a reusable workflow. On.WorkflowDispatch Allows the workflow to be run manually from the GitHub UI or API (workflow_dispatch). On.WorkflowRun Triggers when another workflow runs (workflow_run). On0MatchExtensions Permissions GITHUB_TOKEN permissions at workflow or job level (permissions). This is a discriminated union: use Permissions.All to grant one level to every scope (read-all / write-all), or Permissions.Exact to specify levels per scope. Permissions.All Grants the same Level to every permission scope, rendered as read-all or write-all. Permissions.Exact Grants explicit levels for individual permission scopes. Permissions0MatchExtensions PermissionsEvent Per-scope GITHUB_TOKEN permission levels. Scopes left null are omitted from the YAML and fall back to GitHub's defaults. RunsOn The runner selection for a job (runs-on). Snapshot Runner image snapshot settings for a job (snapshot), used to capture the runner state as a custom image after the job completes. Step A single step within a job. This is a discriminated union: construct a Step.UsesStep to run an action or a Step.RunStep to run shell commands. The properties on this base record are shared by both variants. Step.RunStep A step that runs shell commands (run). Step.UsesStep A step that runs a reusable action (uses), e.g. actions/checkout@v4. Provide inputs via With. Step0MatchExtensions Strategy The execution strategy for a job (strategy), defining a matrix of variations to run. WorkflowDispatchInput A typed input for the workflow_dispatch trigger. This is a discriminated union; construct WorkflowDispatchInput.String, WorkflowDispatchInput.Number, WorkflowDispatchInput.Boolean, or WorkflowDispatchInput.Choice for the desired input type. WorkflowDispatchInput.Boolean A true/false input (type: boolean). WorkflowDispatchInput.Choice A dropdown input restricted to a set of options (type: choice). WorkflowDispatchInput.Number A numeric input (type: number). WorkflowDispatchInput.String A free-text input (type: string). On.PullRequest.PullRequestType Activity types for the pull_request event. On.PullRequestReview.PullRequestReviewType Activity types for the pull_request_review event. On.Release.ReleaseType Activity types for the release event. On.Watch.WatchType Activity types for the watch event. On.WorkflowRun.WorkflowDispatchTypes Activity types for the workflow_run event. api/Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.G.summary: Class GithubActionWriter Namespace Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions Assembly Invex.StructuredText.GithubActions.dll Serializes a GithubAction model to GitHub Actions workflow YAML. Expressions embedded in the model are rendered with GithubExpressionPrinter. public sealed class GithubActionWriter Inheritance object GithubActionWriter Examples var writer = new GithubActionWriter(); writer.Write(workflow); File.WriteAllText(".github/workflows/ci.yml", writer.TextWriter.ToString()); Remarks The writer accumulates output in TextWriter; call ToString() to retrieve the YAML. Use a fresh writer (or Reset(int)) for each workflow file.
